turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
here a time window?

Yes, sometimes an order can be canceled after it’s placed, but it depends on how soon it is scheduled to ship.

In general: • If the order was placed very recently, cancellation may still be possible. • If the order is scheduled to ship soon, it usually needs to be reviewed by our team. • If the order has already shipped, it can no longer be canceled.

If you want, send me your order number or the email used at checkout, and I can check your specific order.

How do I update my contact or account details?

You can update most of your details anytime directly on our website.

Here’s how:

Go to our website and click “Sign In” (top right).
Log in to your account using your email and password.
Once logged in, go to your account/profile area.
Update your contact info there (such as name, email, phone, and saved addresses if available) and save changes.

If you run into any trouble updating something specific (like needing to change the email tied to past orders), you can also contact our team at info@heirloomroses.com or call (800) 820-0465 and they can help make adjustments on their side.

If you tell me which detail you’re trying to change (email, phone, address, name, password), I can walk you through it step by step.
